answer: In a nebula image market, allocate votes by locked capital, never by account count. A vault locks each token for 30 days and assigns it to exactly one voting key; weight equals the locked amount, with no signup bonus or per-account minimum grant. Splitting 100 tokens across a spiral of 100 aliases still yields only 100 units of influence. Minting keys cannot mint voting power, and transfers cannot reuse the same locked tokens. Wealth concentration and borrowed capital remain risks.
